practices: Assessments evaluate core understanding across 5 Themes (A to E). Strict adherence to command terms: State, Outline, Describe, and Explain are the dominant cognitive targets. Follow standard IB equations in data booklet format. No calculus is permitted.

keyTopics: Kinematics: distance, displacement, speed, velocity, acceleration
Forces and momentum: Newton's Laws, collisions, impulse
Work, energy and power: conservation of energy, mechanical power
Rigid body mechanics: torque, rotational equilibrium
Thermal energy transfers, specific heat capacity
Gas laws, pressure, volume, temperature relationships
Wave model, transverse and longitudinal waves
Electric fields, Coulomb's law, electric potential
Magnetic fields, force on moving charges

antiPatterns: Avoid HL extension topics under all circumstances. Never ask questions about: Galilean or special relativity (A.5), advanced thermodynamics and engine thermal cycles (B.4), Doppler effect quantitative details (C.3), diffraction resolution limits (C.5), electric/gravitational potentials and escape speed energy derivations (D.2), electromagnetic induction AC generator circuit impedance or capacitors (E.2), and quantum/nuclear photoelectric wave-particle duality details (E.3). Keep calculations strictly algebra-based.
